summary: SWR checkout regression test BLOCKED — all three provided payment reference links (primary d=294da585... + fallbacks 9352563a... and fa6ad6cd...) return 'This payment link has expired' on the preview host. Neither legacy nor ?swr=1 path can auto-progress past the meta load, so awaiting-state assertions (h1, amount, network/currency selects, pay-status-strip, instruction, QR, address) and verify-polling cadence could not be observed. What WAS verifiable is consistent: both legacy and SWR paths render the IDENTICAL 'expired' fallback screen with no React error boundary, no clean-checkout-error testid, and no red console errors (only a benign 404 on a static resource — most likely favicon — appears on BOTH paths equally). The getData endpoint fires on both paths (legacy: 2 calls, SWR: 1 call after de-dupe), confirming the SWR feature-flag branch at least mounts and requests meta without crashing. No verifyCryptoPayment POSTs were emitted on either path in the 25s window because the checkout short-circuits to the expired state before reaching awaiting — expected given the link state.

rca of the issue: Root cause of test blockage: the three payment link references documented in the review request (including the 'primary' d=294da585...) are all in the 'expired' state on the live prod DB accessed via SAFE MODE. The frontend correctly short-circuits to the ExpiredPayment fallback view before CleanCheckoutV2 mounts its awaiting-state UI, so the SWR-flagged code path (metaSwr → applyMeta → auto-reserve → verifySwr with refreshInterval 10000) never executes. Mitigation: main agent must create/supply a currently-active standard $20 (or any amount) payment link with no expiry in the live prod DB, then re-run this playwright script with the new d= substituted.
